live.title: Live camera
live.intro: The camera view stays on this page. Hints appear while the person gets into position, and the photos are taken automatically once every check passes.

before.stand: Put the phone on a stand at eye level about {{distance}} m away, or have a helper hold it there. Use the rear camera if you can.
before.size: From that distance, the face has to look large enough in the picture to be measured: usually it does with a phone's rear camera at 2× zoom, but not with most laptop webcams. The page tells you if the face is too small. Please do not move closer to fix it: at short distances the nose and mid-face look larger than they are.
before.distance: The report will have no discussion topics, because the page cannot check the camera distance by itself. The measurements are all still shown. Calibrating the distance fixes this, once the camera is on: measure {{distance}} m from the camera with a tape measure, and have the person stand still there for a moment.
before.profile: The side photo is taken with the camera app, as its guide describes.

live.noVoice: This device has no {{language}} voice to read the hints aloud.
live.faceTooSmall: At about {{distance}} m this camera probably cannot show the face large enough to measure: about {{ipd}} px between the pupils, where {{min}} px are needed. Try more zoom, or use the camera app.
live.distanceUnverified: The report will have no discussion topics until the distance is calibrated, because the page cannot check the camera distance by itself.
live.calibrated: The camera distance is checked with this camera's calibration.

calibration.heading: Calibrate the distance
calibration.measure: Measure {{distance}} m from the camera to where the person will stand, with a tape measure.
calibration.stand: The person stands there, faces the camera and holds still until the count is complete.
calibration.done: The camera is calibrated. The distance is now checked for this camera, resolution and zoom.

results.title: Side photo results
results.noScale: The scale from the front photo could not be carried over to this photo, so values in millimetres are not shown.

alar.body: {{metric}} needs this point. It is not on the outline of the face, so it is placed by hand, and the value will be approximate.
alar.bodyGeneric: A measurement of the nose needs this point. It is not on the outline of the face, so it is placed by hand, and the value will be approximate.

landing.lead: This app measures facial proportions from a front photo and a side photo, and shows each measurement next to its reference range.
landing.illustration: A drawing of a result sheet: a photo with measurement lines, and measurements next to their reference ranges

landmarks.heading: Points on the face
landmarks.body: A face landmark model finds points such as the corners of the eyes, the nose and the mouth on the front photo.

hairline.heading: The hairline
hairline.body: The hairline is found with hair segmentation, which tells hair from skin. If it is not found or not placed well, it can be moved by hand.

axes.heading: Along the face's own axes
axes.body: Horizontal and vertical measurements follow the line through the inner corners of the eyes and the line at right angles to it, so a slight head tilt does not change them.

scale.heading: Millimetres
scale.body: Sizes in millimetres use the iris as a ruler: its diameter is about {{mm}} mm in adults and differs between people by about ±4 %.

profile.heading: The side photo
profile.body: Points on the side photo are found on the outline of the face against the background, and the side of the nose is placed by hand. Its millimetres use the scale of the front photo from the same scan.

uncertainty.heading: Precision
uncertainty.body: Every value has an uncertainty, estimated by measuring slightly changed copies of the photo. A value too close to the edge of its range to tell apart from that uncertainty is shown as “{{inconclusive}}”.

reference.heading: Reference ranges
reference.body: Values are compared with the “{{canon}}”. Faces differ naturally, and values outside a range are common.

limits.heading: What the app cannot do
limits.diagnose: It does not diagnose anything or recommend any treatment.
limits.photo: Hair over the forehead, glasses and mirrored photos (from a front camera) change the results.
limits.protocol: The results depend on photos taken as the capture guide describes.

privacy.heading: The photos
privacy.body: Photos are analyzed in memory and are not stored. Closing or reloading the page ends the scan. This device keeps only the language, the last answers about sex and age, and the live camera's calibration if one was made.

report.title: Report
report.exampleRules: These discussion topics come from illustrative example rules, not from rules reviewed and approved by a clinical team.
